text: 国务院原则同意《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，请认真组织实施。规划指出，扩大入境消费。优化入境消费环境，打造“购在中国”品牌。稳步扩大免签国家范围，持续优化过境免签政策。进一步增开国际航线，重点增加欧美、共建“一带一路”国家等国际直航航班数量。提升公共场所国际化服务水平，优化入境消费支付环境，推动入境游客办理快速通关、住宿登记、交通出行、电信业务、景点预约等事务便利化。
text_en: The State Council agreed in principle to the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' requesting serious implementation. The plan points out expanding inbound consumption. The inbound consumption environment will be optimized, building the 'Shop in China' brand. The scope of visa-free countries will be steadily expanded, and transit visa-free policies will be continuously optimized. International flight routes will be increased, focusing on direct flights to Europe, the US, and Belt and Road countries. The internationalization level of public services will be improved, the payment environment for inbound consumption will be optimized, and convenience for inbound travelers in fast customs clearance, hotel registration, transportation, telecom services, and scenic spot bookings will be promoted.
